beats.summary: Michael unintentionally outs Oscar at work, causing tension and discomfort.

evidence.snippet: Toby: OK, Michael, are you aware that you ousted Oscar today?
Oscar: Yes I'm gay. And I didn't plan on sharing that part of my life with you today, so, whatever.

beats.summary: Michael attempts to address the office's discomfort with homosexuality by holding a meeting and encouraging Oscar to come out.

evidence.snippet: Michael (yelling): All right, everybody in the conference room! I don't care if you are gay, or straight, or a lesbian, or overweight! JUST GET IN HERE! RIGHT NOW!

beats.summary: Oscar expresses frustration with Michael's immature and insensitive behavior.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: No, NO! I don't want to touch you, ever consider that? You're ignorant, and insulting, and small!
Oscar: I don't think I can work here any longer. This has been the worst, most backwards day of my life.

beats.summary: Michael publicly embraces Oscar to show support, despite awkwardness and resistance.

evidence.snippet: Michael (sobbing): I'm sorry I called you faggie. You're not faggie. You're a a good guy.
Michael (Dwight gets up to kiss Oscar): Oh come on! Dwight! Come on, man!

beats.summary: Oscar reveals he accepted a three-month paid vacation and company car in exchange for not suing, planning to go to Europe with his roommate Gill.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: I was going to quit. But Jan offered me a three month paid vacation and a company car. All I had to do was sign something saying I won't sue.
